rows.Kwic: 僧問：談玄說妙，𦘕餅充飢；舉古論今，蒸砂作飯。去此二途，如何通信？

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Jieshi Zhipeng (介石智朋禪師語錄), an ascent-seat exchange.
